data.long_meaning: Derived from the word Qadir, meaning Powerful or All-Powerful in Arabic. Qadriyah means the one who is grateful to Allah. The name Qadriyah carries the meaning “The one who is grateful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qadriyah usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who is grateful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
